SsrExample.intro: The post arrives with the first byte of HTML; comments come from a deliberately slow endpoint and stream in through a nested Suspense boundary about two seconds later.
SsrExample.notFoundBody: There is no post with this id. The example data ships a single post.
SsrExample.metaDescription: {title}: a streaming SSR example where the post renders immediately and comments stream in.

WsExample.title: Live WebSocket updates
WsExample.intro: This page is driven by a reusable reconnecting hook: live messages stream in, the connection badge tracks drops and recovery, and an expired session triggers a transparent token refresh before reconnecting.
WsExample.warning: Heads up: WebSocket cookie authentication on the upgrade request is not covered by this repo's test suite (the mock cannot see cookies during the upgrade). Verify it end-to-end against your real backend before relying on it.
WsExample.metaDescription: A live WebSocket example with a reconnecting hook, visible connection state, and auth-expiry recovery.
